changes.title: The White House pushes healthy eating. It cut a landmark nutrition education program
changes.summary: Nutrition advocates and public health experts are mystified by the decision to eliminate SNAP-Ed, given the Trump administration's embrace of the Make America Healthy Again agenda. (Image credit: Rachel Wisniewski for NPR).

changes.title: Secret Service warns of uptick in threats ahead of rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: The Secret Service is warning about a rise in threats ahead of the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, which is set for Friday. CBS News' Nicole Sganga has the latest.

changes.title: Trump escalates threats, vows to target Iranian bridges and power plants
changes.summary: Iranian news agencies are reporting widespread aerial attacks across southern Iran. It comes as President Trump issued more threats against Iran and the Islamic Republic's foreign minister responded that any future attacks would be met with "an eye for an eye." White House correspondent Liz Landers reports.

changes.title: Smithsonian too focused on 'oppressors and the oppressed,' say House Republicans
changes.summary: In a House DOGE subcommittee hearing, GOP representatives excoriated the director of the National Museum of American History, following a White House report earlier this month that also criticized her. (Image credit: Andrew Harnik).
